goal: Coordinate an Idea-Spark discussion-until-gate review in default CLI-first mode. Use `hermes idea-spark call <operation> --json-file <payload>` for room operations unless explicit tool-mode has been enabled and the Hermes session reset. After room creation, report the returned room_url only after dashboard_reachable=true or another health check passes; otherwise report the dashboard_warning and room_id instead of a dead link. Join/read the room state, then launch bounded child rounds outside the plugin CLI/tool handlers. Use phase order: Seed / Framing; Novelty Attack; Weakness / Feasibility Attack; Author Rebuttal / Improvement Draft; Re-review / Cross-examination; Gate. max_rounds=4. After each phase call idea_spark_room_status and stop only after has_terminal_gate=true. Gatekeeper must call idea_spark_gate_record with close_room=true for the terminal gate. A message-only gate is not final. If max_rounds is exhausted without an accept/reject/supersede/retract decision, record needs_more_evidence as the terminal gate. Do not call skill_manage.
context: room_id=<ROOM_ID>; dashboard_room_url=<ROOM_URL>; idea_summary=<IDEA_SUMMARY>; payload_scratch_root=/tmp/idea_spark_<RUN_ID>/; required placeholders to replace before use: <ROOM_ID>, <ROOM_URL>, <IDEA_SUMMARY>. Default child roles use toolsets=["terminal", "file", "skills"] and write JSON payloads under payload_scratch_root/<agent_id>/ for `hermes idea-spark call`. Explicit tool-mode child roles may use toolsets=["idea_spark", "skills"] only after `$HERMES_HOME/idea-spark/config.json` enables tools and the session reset. Children must call idea_spark_room_join first, load skill_view(name="idea-spark:idea-spark-usage") when protocol details are needed, write at least one message and one typed artifact when substantive content exists, use phase/phase="*"/phases=[...] for round_wait barriers, use idea_spark_need_create / idea_spark_need_update for evidence gaps, and never treat summaries or messages as final gates. max_rounds=4; stop only after has_terminal_gate=true; Gatekeeper must call idea_spark_gate_record.
